name: פְּרָת
summary: Perath is the Hebrew name of the Euphrates, the fourth river in the Eden account. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The clause וְהַנָּהָר הָרְבִיעִי הוּא פְרָת identifies the fourth river by name.

note: Moved from the former word entry `pperaat` (old root key פרת).
